subject.title: refactor(diffs): move ephemeral artifacts to SQLite

question: Should this PR globally revoke privileged plugin-state access from official npm-pack and source-path installs, or should the new BLOB store use a narrower capability gate while existing openKeyedStore eligibility remains compatible?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes package-provenance trust semantics across existing and new Plugin SDK APIs; code correctness cannot determine the permanent security-versus-local-install compatibility policy.

options.title: Separate the gates
options.body: Preserve existing openKeyedStore eligibility and apply a distinct, documented trusted-official requirement to openBlobStore until the broader trust model is resolved.

options.title: Approve the global break
options.body: Keep the shared tightened predicate, but explicitly accept affected local installs, add upgrade diagnostics and documentation, and prove the resulting failure and recovery paths.

options.title: Defer the public API
options.body: Keep Diffs on an internal bundled capability and postpone the public openBlobStore contract until the external-plugin trust policy is settled.

recommendation.title: Separate the gates
recommendation.body: Preserve existing openKeyedStore eligibility and apply a distinct, documented trusted-official requirement to openBlobStore until the broader trust model is resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects steipete to the affected plugin trust, storage, and Diffs architecture surfaces.
